profile_cpu_gpu_time: use the profile_time context manager to measure CPU and GPU time spent in a code block
profile_cuda_stream: profile a specific CUDA stream by passing the stream argument to profile_time
profile_with_custom_name: use profile_time with a custom trace_name and name to label timing output
profile_async_code: use profile_time to find sweet spots of code suitable for async implementation
profile_with_end_stream: use profile_time with a separate end_stream to record the end event on a different CUDA stream
